tiers.name: Tier 1: 各业务部门烟囱式独占 GPU 部署 (16 个部门各占 1 套 70B 实例 · 85.5% 算力空转)
tiers.name_en: Tier 1: Departmental GPU Silos (16 BUs x Dedicated Instances · 85.5% Idle Waste)
tiers.platform_architecture: 16 Separate 70B Deployments (32 GPUs Total, 1,120 GB Duplicate Base Weights, Zero Cross-BU Elasticity)

tiers.name: Tier 4: 企业级 MaaS 中台 (多 LoRA 池 + AI 网关 Token 精准分账 + 三级 QoS 抢占 + 夜间潮汐混部)
